beats.title: The invisible journey
beats.narration: When you open a website, several different systems cooperate behind the scenes. Your browser is only the beginning.

beats.title: A chain of events
beats.narration: First the browser resolves a domain name. Then a connection is established, a request is sent, and a response comes back.

beats.title: Every millisecond matters
beats.narration: Imagine an illustrative request budget of five hundred milliseconds. This number is only an example, not a universal web performance benchmark.
beats.label: Illustrative latency budget

beats.title: Two hypothetical results
beats.narration: In a made up comparison, a cached answer takes forty five milliseconds, while an uncached request takes three hundred milliseconds. Real timing varies with conditions.
